planets.name: WASP-13 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Gloas with a 4.35-day year, found in 2009.

text.card: WASP-13 b was found in 2009 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Gloas. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2009, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.35301101, pl_radj 1.22, pl_bmassj 0.36

quotes.title: WASP-13b
quotes.card: WASP-13b, also known as Cruinlagh, is an extrasolar planet that was discovered in 2008 in the orbit of the sunlike star WASP-13.
quotes.introduction: The planet has a mass of nearly half that of Jupiter, but a radius five-quarters of the size of Jupiter.
